dpanel.desc:
DPanel 是一款轻量化的管理 Docker、Podman 容器的可视化面板。
原生的中文的界面，更适合中文环境使用。同时支持英文、日文等多种语言。安装简单，占用资源极低，更适合各种 Nas 设备、盒子以及小型服务器。面板提供了容器、Compose、镜像等容器管理的基础功能。支持管理容器内部文件，支持多种类型添加 Compose 项目。可以通过 Docker Api 和 SSH 的方式添加、管理多个 Docker 服务端。
dpanel.changelog:
feat: redesign the Overview page with host resource monitoring, health indicators, resource trends, and Docker usage statistics feat: switch Overview resource metrics between Docker and host data, and show Compose projects awaiting deployment feat: add built-in and custom Overview shortcuts, with URL links that can open designated dialogs directly feat: unify file management for panel data, host files, SSH-connected Docker hosts, containers, and volumes feat: copy, move, and rename files; manage ownership and permissions; calculate directory sizes feat: create ZIP, TAR, and TAR.GZ archives and extract supported compressed files in the file manager feat: allow the file manager proxy container to be cleaned up when its dialog closes, with a saved preference feat: add Passkey sign-in, credential management, and global settings in Pro Edition feat: combine panel logs, Docker events, and the latest panel upgrade log in System Logs, with search, filtering, raw panel log download, and cleanup feat: discover container ports and check their reachability from the panel feat: connect to Docker inside WSL distributions on Windows feat: save image build configurations separately from execution, with build progress and cancellation feat: synchronize Compose project directories before deployments started from the UI or CLI feat: allow creating an empty task in Compose feat: show the console command line in Compose details feat: offer registry mirror configuration when an image pull fails in the pull dialog feat: add the CLI `-q` option to suppress successful command result output fix: restore the `system:backup` CLI command and normalize selected backup paths fix: support Windows CMD in the web console and improve Windows file-system compatibility fix: allow image builds to be cancelled immediately after they start fix: prevent container execution and host-monitoring processes from remaining active after their work ends fix: close WebSocket connections when requests are interrupted and clean up file manager proxy containers at the correct time fix: synchronize Compose directory data to remote Docker environments before deployment fix: restore host-mounted directories and files correctly from container snapshots fix: remove eligible unused images during cleanup fix: complete Docker event details and reduce low-priority event notifications fix: validate custom security entrance paths and refresh login credentials after administrator account changes fix: correct console log font settings, scrolling in container JSON details, translations, and excessive log output fix: improve Buildx configuration behavior and image pull error feedback fix: restore icon retrieval for Overview shortcuts fix: show the correct host memory usage when Docker runs in an LXC environment with a cgroup memory limit fix: recognize common Redis and Apache log timestamps and severity levels fix: restore the previous Buildx builder if recreating it fails fix: prevent saved image build ZIP files from being deleted when their upload entries are removed fix: display the Pro Edition security entrance logo and generate panel upgrade commands correctly fix: disable list actions for the DPanel container and provide a shortcut to System Upgrade fix: support Kylin Linux (#324) refactor: manage Agent as a system component and reduce the file manager helper's privileges refactor: route Compose directory synchronization through the unified file manager refactor: improve Buildx context configuration, creation, cleanup, and image-build integration refactor: align container command execution with local and SSH executors, and support ZIP-to-TAR conversion for builds

增加 全新概览页，展示主机资源监控、运行健康状态、资源趋势及 Docker 用量统计 增加 概览资源指标支持切换 Docker 与主机数据，并展示待部署的 Compose 项目数量 增加 概览内置与自定义快捷方式，支持通过 URL 直达指定弹窗 增加 统一文件管理入口，管理面板数据、主机、通过 SSH 连接的 Docker 主机、容器和存储卷中的文件 增加 文件复制、移动、重命名、所有者和权限管理，以及目录体积计算 增加 文件管理器内创建 ZIP、TAR、TAR.GZ 压缩包，并解压受支持的压缩文件 增加 文件管理器关闭时可清理代理容器，并保存该行为的开关偏好 增加 专业版 Passkey 登录、凭证管理及全局配置 增加 系统日志，整合面板日志、Docker 事件和最近一次面板升级日志，支持搜索、筛选、下载原始面板日志及清理 增加 容器端口发现和连通性检测 增加 Windows 环境连接 WSL 发行版中的 Docker 增加 镜像构建配置可单独保存，再执行构建，并展示进度与中止操作 增加 从界面或命令行部署 Compose 前同步项目目录 增加 Compose 支持创建空任务 增加 Compose 详情展示控制台命令行 增加 镜像拉取弹窗失败后提示配置镜像仓库加速地址 增加 命令行 `-q` 参数，静默输出成功命令的结果 修复 缺少 `system:backup` 命令，并归一化指定的备份路径 修复 Web 控制台的 Windows CMD 支持及 Windows 文件系统兼容问题 修复 镜像构建刚开始时无法中止 修复 容器命令执行和主机监控进程结束后仍可能残留 修复 请求中断后 WebSocket 未关闭，以及文件管理代理容器销毁时机不正确 修复 远程 Docker 环境部署 Compose 前项目目录数据未同步 修复 容器快照恢复时挂载的主机目录和文件未正确恢复 修复 清理未使用镜像时部分符合条件的镜像未被移除 修复 Docker 事件信息不完整，并减少低优先级事件通知 修复 自定义安全入口路径校验，以及管理员账号变更后的登录凭证刷新问题 修复 控制台日志字体配置、容器 JSON 详情滚动、多语言文案及日志输出过多的问题 修复 Buildx 配置及镜像拉取错误反馈中的问题 修复 概览快捷方式无法获取图标 修复 Docker 运行在受 cgroup 内存限制的 LXC 环境时，主机内存用量显示不正确 修复 Redis、Apache 等常见日志的时间和级别识别不正确 修复 重新创建 Buildx 构建器失败时未恢复原有构建器 修复 移除镜像构建 ZIP 上传项时可能误删已保存的文件 修复 专业版安全入口标志不显示、面板升级命令生成异常 修复 DPanel 自身容器仍可使用列表操作，并提供快速跳转至系统升级的入口 修复 不支持麒麟系统的问题（#324） 优化 将 Agent 作为系统组件管理，收敛文件管理助手权限 优化 通过统一文件管理能力完成 Compose 项目目录同步 优化 Buildx 上下文配置、创建、清理及镜像构建的调用流程 优化 容器命令执行与本地、SSH 执行器的行为一致性，并支持构建时将 ZIP 转换为 TAR
